old_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of a single diamond ring placed on an open book. The ring is positioned upright, and the camera remains stationary. The book beneath it has visible text, though it is not entirely legible due to the angle and focus on the ring. The background is dark, which makes the ring stand out prominently. The lighting is soft yet focused, highlighting the sparkle and brilliance of the diamond. The ring slowly rotates on the book, providing different angles and perspectives. This movement allows viewers to appreciate the intricate details and craftsmanship of the jewelry. The shadow of the ring is cast on the book, adding depth to the scene. The overall atmosphere is one of sophistication and elegance, emphasizing the beauty and value of the ring.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of two elegant diamond rings placed on an open book. The rings are positioned side by side, with one slightly overlapping the other. The book beneath them has visible text, though it is not entirely legible due to the angle and focus on the rings. The background is dark, which makes the rings stand out prominently. The lighting is soft yet focused, highlighting the sparkle and brilliance of the diamonds. As the video progresses, the camera slowly pans around the rings, providing different angles and perspectives. This movement allows viewers to appreciate the intricate details and craftsmanship of the jewelry. The shadow of the rings is cast on the wall behind, adding depth to the scene. The overall atmosphere is one of sophistication and elegance, emphasizing the beauty and value of the rings.
caption: The video showcases two diamond rings standing upright on a white sheet printed with rows of text, against a dark background. Their silhouettes are nearly merged, so the pair reads as a single band with one bright stone head. As the viewing angle shifts, the overlapping forms separate into two distinct rings. The right-hand ring reveals a pavé band, while the left-hand ring shows a plainer band. The cast shadow changes from a single loop into two overlapping loops and shifts its shape. Printed rows of text slide across the paper and tilt in the frame. Star-shaped glints flash from the stones and metal as the angle changes. The rings remain upright and in contact with the paper throughout the excerpt. Their relative positions open from alignment into side-by-side separation, with sparkle and shadow still shifting across the scene.

Write a corrected WISA-style training caption for this exact video clip.
This clip is a temporally cropped excerpt, with arbitrary start and end boundaries. It is NOT
necessarily a complete action and it is NOT a loop. Describe the visible portion of a process
without inventing how it began or how it ultimately ends. A process may already be happening
on the first frame and still be happening after the last. Do not force the endpoints to match,
infer a physical error from their mismatch, or manufacture continuity across a visible edit.
Use the chronological video as primary evidence. The independent visual notes are fallible aids,
not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.
You receive the original WISA caption's stylistic profile, without its possibly wrong facts.
Retain its English narrative voice, viewpoint, paragraph structure and level of visual detail.
Aim for 85-115% of the original WISA word count,
and retain supported scene details while clearly describing the main visible process. Do not
replace it with a short keyword prompt, physics explanation, checklist or a generic summary.
Correct wrong subjects, actions, directions, contacts, temporal ordering and completion claims.
Distinguish an already ongoing process from a new event actually visible within this excerpt.
Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
